checks: Byte-identical to upstream: the chat_template field of tokenizer_config.json (JSON-decoded) in deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 at revision 56d4cbbb4d29 equals the text (go run ./tools/feedbuild upstream re-checks it). Last checked 2026-10-14.

Socair's chat-template check (defilantech/socair@ddfe650b5f50, the RealTemplates corpus gate, 2026-10-14): PASS, with no code reach and no content-conditional injection; rendered 5 of 6 probe conversations (1 refused: the tool call and result probe, because the template concatenates tool-call arguments as a string and the probe passes an object); text it adds of its own: nothing; nothing is added under a content condition.
notes: Concatenates all system messages after the BOS token, then writes turns with the full-width markers <｜User｜> and <｜Assistant｜>, tool calls and outputs with DeepSeek's tool markers, and <｜Assistant｜><think> newline at the generation prompt. One condition reads message text: an assistant message containing </think> keeps only the text after it, which removes the earlier reasoning rather than adding anything. This text is the R1 repository's; the R1 Distill repositories were not checked and are not covered.

review.means: A person read the whole template text at the pinned revision and confirmed that it only lays out the conversation it is given: it adds no instruction to the model beyond the publisher's own default system prompt and tool scaffolding, no branch adds text when a message contains a particular string, and it reaches nothing but the documented chat-template variables and filters. Byte identity with the upstream file and Socair's chat-template check are mechanical checks, listed under checks; they are not the review.
